# Japan Trip Planning Notes

## Cities

- Tokyo for museums, neighborhoods, and rail access
- Kyoto for temples and quieter mornings
- Osaka for food and one-day side trips

## Rail strategy

Do not buy a nationwide rail pass by default. Compare individual intercity tickets first because regional passes can be cheaper.

## Packing reminders

- compact rain jacket
- comfortable walking shoes
- coin pouch for transit and lockers

## Booking checklist

- check whether hotel laundry is available
- reserve at least one luggage-forwarding day for the Kyoto move
- keep passport scan and insurance confirmation offline
